active_evidence.budgets: Environment calls, updates, training input/padded/supervised tokens, examples and initial adapter hashes are checked across arms. Acquisition-model inference tokens are separately logged and are not equalized; no equal-total-compute interpretation is warranted.
active_evidence.durable_updates: Training checks finite nonzero gradients and changed adapter hashes. Post-stage evaluation reloads adapter tensors onto a newly loaded base, verifies exact probe logits, and restores optimizer state. This is a new model object in the same process, not a fresh evaluator process.
active_evidence.freeze: Base parameters are excluded from optimization and frozen gradients are rejected. Base equality on the 4B path uses parameter probes rather than a full-state hash.
active_evidence.generalization_boundary: The raw-input split changes nuisance-bit combinations. Because b5-b9 are explicitly irrelevant, raw-input disjointness alone must not be described as a disjoint causal truth-table split. Device-composition prompts are separately scored.
active_evidence.hypothesis_privilege: The family is public in every prompt; the exact-family selector is explicitly named an oracle. Selection receives queried observations and candidates, not the hidden rule or held-out labels. True-specification evaluations are separate frozen-base anchors.
active_evidence.primary_metric: Forced choice over binary answer tokens; unrestricted token accuracy and answer-token mass are also present. No LLM judge is used.
active_evidence.training_evaluation_overlap: Exact 10-bit acquisition and held-out values are separated by partition; collect_arm asserts no held-out acquisition value. Stable device 0 has no stage-1 training.

portability.budgets: B minibatch order and example count are independent of replay. Replay intentionally adds A exposure/computation, and native versus LoRA capacity differs; both are explicitly disclosed feasibility controls.
portability.checkpoint_and_context: Training exits before a uv-launched evaluation process. Checkpoint tensor hashes, process identity and deterministic probe logits are checked. Held-out files are not opened by the training reader.
portability.frozen_state: Base, old task vectors and alignment are frozen and hashed. The new latent-only config sets train_core=false and excludes core parameters from the optimizer; replay with frozen core is rejected.
portability.gradient_path: Training calls portal(new_z), not inference-only portal.generate. Installed portallib 0.2.1 PortalInjector preserves autograd during factor placement. The independent one-backward probe below confirms nonzero core and new-vector gradients.

prepared_data_check.boundary: This checks the existing prepared artifact. Current parquet-loading code additionally verifies file hashes; the GPU-side files were not reopened by this audit.

portability.published_a_boundary: The protocol explicitly calls published A validation a release/regression measure, not novel unseen A acquisition.
portability.retention_control: The current LoRA branch unloads the B adapter and actually reevaluates routed published A behavior; it no longer substitutes the initialization score.
portability.source_provenance: Source and target shared core/task tensors must hash equally before extension. The final target original shared state is checked again before transport. Config revisions are pinned; local snapshots are checked and current parquet inputs have declared hashes.
portability.transport: Updated core and all task vectors are copied onto original target alignment with no B target calibration. Evaluation compares target raw, original-artifact initialization and transported state.

native_portal_backward.fixture: existing tests/test_contract.py tiny fixture; one backward, no test files saved
native_portal_backward.proof_limit: Tiny CPU graph qualification only. Does not establish published-artifact learnability, GPU correctness, retention, or transport quality.

findings.impact: A kept acquisition contrast does not establish retained old-task ability. This is narrower than the handoff claim of no material retention regression and the campaign durable-learning criterion. The mini config is unaffected because it always reports qualification_only.
findings.observed_behavior: summarize subtracts the random arm retention change from the candidate retention change. It never bounds the candidate own stable_retention_change before returning keep_for_independent_replication.
findings.requested_change: Before calling a keep decision retention-preserving, require the candidate stable_retention_change to be at least minus an explicit absolute forgetting threshold, and include that value in the decision row. If the desired endpoint is only a relative acquisition effect, retain the contrast but label it separately from a retained-skill success.
findings.title: The relative retention gate can keep a candidate that forgets the entire retained task
findings.verification: The counterexample must cease being a retention-qualified positive, while a candidate within the absolute forgetting threshold can still qualify.

findings.impact: The main portable-new-skill signal is reported only as a point difference despite the registered program-block reporting requirement. The 256 composition rows contain 32 programs with eight correlated start states each; the program-level information count matters when reviewing a small transport gain.
findings.observed_behavior: The keep rule uses new_b_transport_gain >= 0.05, but paired_program_interval is called only for results.learned versus results.raw/initial on the training backbone. No paired interval is emitted for results.transport.learned versus either transport floor.
findings.requested_change: Reuse paired_program_interval for transported B versus both target raw and target initial predictions and emit those descriptive intervals beside new_b_transport_gain. This can be computed from saved predictions without another GPU run; keep the declared boundary that intervals do not cover training-seed uncertainty.
findings.title: The transported-skill promotion signal has no program-block uncertainty report
findings.verification: A completed native arm includes paired program counts and intervals for both transport baselines, using matched prediction IDs and labels.
